title: Principal-open sections of higher direct images have denominator bounds
statement: Let f : X → T be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], F a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent], q a natural number and W an affine open of T. Let M = R^q f_* F [pqf-def-cohomology], a ∈ Γ(T,W), and let r be the restriction from W to the principal open D(a). For every s ∈ Γ(M,D(a)), there are n ≥ 0 and t ∈ Γ(M,W) with r(t) = (a|D(a))^n s.

source.place: Lemma 30.17.3, tensor-unit specialization, combined with Tag 01E4 and the localization criterion for quasi-coherence used in Tag 01XJ (1).

proof.text: Choose the library injective resolution I of F; set K=f_*I and P=sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q. Apply raw cohomology principal localization to every affine open of T.

Let c:P^# → R^qf_*F be the canonical section-cohomology comparison followed by I.isoRightDerivedObj inverse. higherDirectImagePresheaf proves c is an isomorphism. The affine localization sheafification theorem makes the unit on every affine U invertible. The adjunction formula theta = unit followed by forget(c) then proves theta is an isomorphism on every affine U, in particular D(a).

Lift s along the bijective theta(D(a)). Apply Mathlib IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj to its lift x, obtaining n and y in P(W) with a^n x = res(y). Set t=theta(W)(y). Naturality of theta transports res(y); linearity of theta(D(a)) and map_pow transport the scalar a^n, giving exactly res(t)=(res(a))^n s.

lean.statement: theorem higherDirectImage_section_clearDenominators (q : ℕ) (W : T.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (a : Γ(T, W)) (s : Γ((higherDirectImage f q).obj ℱ, T.basicOpen a)) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ((higherDirectImage f q).obj ℱ, W)), ((higherDirectImage f q).obj ℱ).presheaf.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op t = T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op a ^ n • s
